jobs.description:
Our client is a leading player in the financial services sector, known for its strong customer orientation, professional development opportunities, and collaborative culture. The company invests heavily in its employees and offers a stable environment where talent can grow and develop.

Jobomschrijving

• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers.

You play a key role in the company's business development in the automotive sector and are responsible for managing the entire sales cycle with a B2B client base.

Client Details

We are a fast-growing company specializing in car leasing, and we are looking for a junior sales profile to strengthen our teams in Brussels.

 

 

Description

Junior Sales Automotive (M.F.X) - Your tasks:

• You develop the company's B2B business and are responsible for managing the entire sales cycle with a corporate client base 
• You will be trained by the sales team 
• You are comfortable with prospecting and can understand the needs of potential clients 
• You negotiate and close deals 
• You contribute to improving the sales pitch and overall strategy 

Junior Sales Automotive (M.F.X) - Your profile:

• You are ambitious and eager to grow quickly 
• You have an interest in the automotive sector 
• You have between 0 and 3 years of experience in sales (startup, tech, B2B…) 
• You are results-oriented and driven to perform 
• You are curious and attentive to customer needs 
• You are fluent in French and have a good level of English

Accountant – The Role:
 

You will report to the Finance Manager and be part of a close-knit accounting team. Your role is varied and involves frequent interaction with colleagues from various departments.
 

Daily accounting: You will process payments from customers and suppliers and reconcile the entries with bank statements.
 

Invoicing and follow-up on outstanding invoices: You prepare sales invoices and send them to
 customers; you follow up on outstanding receivables and take action in the event of
 late payments.
 

Reporting: You collect data for the weekly profitability reports and the monthly KPI reports.
 

Reconciliations: You perform periodic (monthly and annual) reconciliations with customers and suppliers 
 

Invoice verification and collaboration with operations: You review and approve invoices from port, terminal, and administrative suppliers

 Accountant – About You:
 

-
 You have at least a first experience as an in-house accountant, or in an accounting firm
 

-
 You are fluent in Dutch & English
 

-
 You have obtained a degree in Accounting, or in a relevant field
 

-
 An experience in the logistics sector is definitely a plus, but not essential

Your Role

For a leading American multinational company in the consumer products industry, recognized worldwide for its innovation and commitment to quality, we are currently looking for a Lab Associate to strengthen the team. This is a unique opportunity to work in a high-tech environment where safety, quality, and continuous improvement are at the forefront. Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and eager to work in a modern laboratory setting? Then this position may be the perfect fit for you. In this role: 

 
• you will be responsible for a variety of laboratory activities carried out in accordance with established procedures 
 
•  
 You will organize, set up, and perform stability testing using a range of laboratory instruments, including pH meters, viscometers, colorimeters, ovens, incubators, and climate chambers. 

 
•  
 You will test the enzymatic activity of finished products using a spectrophotometer, following standard operating procedures. 

 
•  
 You will collect various samples, including water samples, swabs, ambient plates, and raw materials, ensuring proper sampling techniques are applied. 

 
• You will be responsible for sampling incoming materials and preparing them for laboratory analysis. 
 
• You will plan and perform FTIR testing when required, maintaining a high level of accuracy throughout the process. 
 
• You will ensure accurate administration and data management by entering and maintaining laboratory data in the relevant systems. 
 
•  
 You will act as a communication link between departments and suppliers, proactively helping to resolve issues when they arise.

 
• You hold at least an A2 diploma in Science/Chemistry or have relevant laboratory experience. 
 
• You have a good command of English, both written and spoken (mandatory). 
 
• You are familiar with Microsoft Office applications and can use them confidently and efficiently.

Are you ready to make data trustworthy, well-managed and truly valuable across an organisation? As a Data Governance Senior Consultant at BDO, you will help organisations design and embed the frameworks, operating models and ways of working that keep data reliable, well-governed and fit for strategic and operational decision-making. Join a team that values expertise, client proximity and pragmatism, and contribute and lead high-impact data governance projects in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
What will you be doing?
In this role, you will act as a Data Governance expert across multiple projects and clients, designing and delivering all-round governance frameworks and operating models while helping teams grow their capabilities. Here’s what you’ll be doing:

• Collaborate with clients: Work closely with stakeholders to understand their data landscape, governance maturity, business requirements and strategic objectives
• Design governance frameworks & operating models: Develop and implement pragmatic, all-round data governance frameworks — policies, standards, roles and responsibilities, and operating models — tailored to each organisation’s needs and level of maturity.
• Establish roles & accountability: Define and embed data ownership and stewardship structures, decision rights and governance bodies (councils, forums) that make governance stick.
• Improve data quality & management: Set up frameworks for data quality, metadata, lineage and master data, translating governance principles into practical, day-to-day ways of working.
• Improve decision performance: Identify opportunities to optimise data management processes, performance management and the overall governance operating model.
• Support change and adoption: Coach and train stakeholders to ensure strong adoption, cultural buy-in and the long-term value of the governance frameworks you put in place.
• Leverage BDO’s network: Collaborate with colleagues across Finance, IT, Risk, Strategy and other practices to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions for clients.
• Coach and enable teams: Contribute actively to peer coaching, knowledge sharing and team enablement, and support the growth of colleagues by spreading expertise, mentoring on the job and strengthening data governance capabilities across the team.
What do you bring to the table?
We are looking for someone who combines strong analytical skills with a consulting mindset and a passion for well-managed data. You bring:

• Relevant experience: 5+ years of experience in Data Governance, Data Management or a closely related field, ideally within a consulting or project-based environment, with a track record of leading initiatives end to end.
• Educational background: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data, Engineering, Business Economics or a related field.
• Language proficiency: Fluent in either French or Dutch, with a very good knowledge of English.
• Governance expertise: Solid experience designing and implementing data governance frameworks and operating models. Covering roles and responsibilities, policies, standards, data quality, metadata and stewardship, in a tool-neutral, process- and framework-first way.
• Balanced technical & advisory profile: Comfortable moving between hands-on technical understanding with light implementation work (data models, data platforms, data quality and metadata concepts) and advisory work on operating models, policies and governance strategy.
• Scalable delivery: Proven interest or expertise in scaling governance delivery through reusable templates, accelerators, best practices and automation where relevant.
• Business understanding: Ability to translate business needs and governance principles into practical, value-driven and adoptable solutions.
• Communication & leadership: Excellent communication skills and the ability to interact with, and influence, both business and technical stakeholders up to senior level.
• Consulting skills: Strong problem-solving, project management and change management capabilities.
• Consulting exposure: Comfortable operating as a governance expert across several projects and clients in parallel, adapting quickly to different business contexts while maintaining quality and consistency.
• Motivation: A strong desire to help grow a data governance practice and actively contribute to its development.

jobs.occupation: Senior Technical Project Lead – Data Lifecycle Management
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Lead the implementation of the Data Retention Initiative to turn information policies into operational practice.
• Define and execute end-to-end Data Lifecycle Management plans across diverse business units and systems.
• Manage cross-functional delivery by engaging with senior stakeholders and business units in a complex environment.
• Perform technology assessments, RFP selections, and enterprise-wide implementations for information governance tools.
• Oversee technical delivery aspects including archival jobs, data-expiry configuration, scripting, and integration.
• Translate regulatory requirements such as GDPR and NIS 2 into actionable retention and deletion obligations.
• Implement classification and tagging strategies for security, privacy, and structured data identification.

Requirements

• 8+ years of professional experience in IT, data management, or information governance within large organizations.
• 3+ years of specialized experience in data lifecycle management, records and retention, or archiving.
• Proven track record leading cross-functional delivery involving senior stakeholders in complex environments.
• Deep domain expertise in IMPs, retention schedules, legal hold, and archiving.
• Technical proficiency in scripting, integration, and archival jobs to drive deletion at scale.
• Experience with Microsoft Purview for retention and enforcement across M365.
• Working knowledge of regulatory drivers for data retention, specifically GDPR and NIS 2.
• Master’s degree in IT, Data Management, or a related field.
• Strong experience in stakeholder management and change leadership across decentralized organizations.
• You have a native level of Dutch or French with at least B2 level in the other and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with SharePoint Advanced Management.
• Familiarity with data governance & cataloguing tools, e-archiving, or structured-data expiry.
• Certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/SAFe, or DAMA CDMP.
• Microsoft Information Protection & Compliance Administrator or other Purview certifications.
• Knowledge of ISO 27001, EU Data Act, or EU AI Act.

What will you be doing?
Forget theoretical innovation plans. You turn ideas into action. You identify opportunities, build prototypes, test tools, and make sure innovation truly lands within our accounting teams.

• Accelerate the accounting innovation roadmap – Co-develop and execute a pragmatic innovation roadmap aligned with the strategic priorities of our accounting department. You help define where we go next — and make it happen.
• Turn business needs into concrete solutions – Translate requirements from accounting teams into proofs of concept, prototypes and pilots. You bridge the gap between business and technology.
• Experiment hands-on with new tools – Explore and test data analytics, BI tools, RPA, ML/AI prototypes, workflow automation and collaborative solutions. You don't just talk innovation — you build it.
• Drive pilots and adoption – Coordinate pilot trajectories with internal teams and member firms, define impact and risk assessments, and ensure smooth adoption within accounting practice.
• Measure what matters – Establish clear KPIs to quantify traction, time savings and quality improvements. You make impact visible and measurable.
• Enable and inspire colleagues – Develop training materials, onboard users and support change processes. You help colleagues embrace new ways of working with confidence.
• Safeguard quality and compliance – Ensure new technologies are implemented in line with accounting standards, quality requirements and regulatory expectations.
What do you bring to the table?
Your foundation:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Accounting, Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent
• 2–5 years of experience within accounting or strong affinity with accounting processes (experience in relevant tech roles is also valued)
• Hands-on experience with data analytics, BI tools, RPA, workflow automation or ML/AI proofs of concept
• Ability to build prototypes or drive R&D initiatives based on structured requirement lists
• Strong stakeholder management skills: you translate business challenges into practical technical solutions
• Fluency in English and Dutch or French
Your personality:

• You think like an entrepreneur and focus on creating tangible, visible impact
• You combine analytical strength with creativity and a true "test-and-learn" mentality
• You are proactive and independent, yet thrive in collaboration with partners, IT and business teams
• You communicate clearly and create buy-in across different stakeholder levels
• You balance innovation with a strong awareness of quality and compliance risks
• You're flexible and eager to promote smarter, future-proof ways of working

Are you ready to turn data into meaningful business decisions? Join a team that values expertise, client proximity and pragmatism, and contribute to high‑impact data projects in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

In this role, you will act as a Business Intelligence expert across multiple projects and clients, designing and delivering impactful BI and Data Analytics solutions while helping teams grow their capabilities. Here’s what you’ll be doing:

 

• Collaborate with clients: Work closely with stakeholders to understand business requirements, decision-making challenges and strategic objectives.
• Design and implement BI solutions: Develop and deploy aesthetic, intuitive and user-friendly reporting, dashboarding and analytics solutions tailored to each organisation’s needs, with a strong focus on UX/UI in BI and storytelling with data.
• Analyse and model data: Design robust data models, ensure data quality and transform complex datasets into actionable insights.

What do you bring to the table?
We are looking for someone who combines strong analytical skills with a consulting mindset and a passion for data. You bring:

• Relevant experience: 2+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics or decision support, preferably within a consulting or project-based environment.
• Educational background: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data, Engineering, Business Economics or a related field.
• Language proficiency: Fluent in either French or Dutch, with a very good knowledge of English.
• Technical expertise: Strong experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik…), data modelling, SQL and data platforms, combined with a passion for designing scalable BI solutions and creating intuitive, high-quality dashboards.

• Consulting skills: Strong problem‑solving, project management and change management capabilities.
• Consulting exposure: Comfortable operating as a BI expert across several projects and clients in parallel, adapting quickly to different business contexts while maintaining quality and consistency.
• Motivation: A strong desire to join a growing BI & Data team and actively contribute to its development.

jobs.occupation: Data Architect – Data Anonymization & Test Data Management
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Analyze end-to-end data flows across the application landscape to identify data minimization and protection requirements.
• Develop and implement a comprehensive strategy for data anonymization, pseudonymization, and synthetic data generation.
• Facilitate workshops with diverse stakeholders from business, IT security, and enterprise architecture to align technical constraints with regulatory obligations.
• Define functional and technical requirements to support future procurement processes and market consultations for data management tools.
• Maintain referential integrity and business usability of structured and unstructured data in non-production environments.
• Ensure the protection of personal and sensitive data through effective data selection and minimization strategies.

Requirements

• 7+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Data Governance, Data Management, or Data Engineering.
• Proven experience analyzing and documenting end-to-end data flows across multiple applications and databases.
• Experience with Data Masking, Anonymization, Pseudonymization, or Synthetic Data.
• Proven experience translating testing objectives into concrete test data requirements for functional, integration, and performance testing.
• Experience analyzing, optimizing, and documenting security processes and governance.
• You possess strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to structure complex situations independently.
• You're able to work autonomously and provide end-to-end deliverables.
• You are fluent in English with fluency in French or Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience defining functional and technical requirements for a Tender, RFP, or product selection process.
• Master’s degree in Science, Law, or IT.
• Knowledge of security management frameworks such as ISO 2700x, COBIT, NIST, or OWASP.

Shape the future of audit methodology and technology

Ready to combine your audit expertise with innovation and methodology? Perfect timing! We’re looking for a Technical Specialist – Audit & Assurance Technology & Standards.

If you enjoy translating complex audit standards into practical tools, improving the way auditors work, and collaborating on technology-driven improvements within audit, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a real impact.

You’ll act as the operational link between our Audit & Assurance Tech & Innovation Committee and the Technical (A&A Compliance) team, ensuring that new technologies, evolving standards and audit methodology move forward together.
What will you be doing?
Forget static methodologies that gather dust. You keep our audit approach sharp, practical and future-proof.

• Translate evolving standards into practice – Monitor new audit standards, regulatory updates and guidance from the BDO network. You analyse the impact and convert these developments into concrete updates for methodology, templates and guidance used by our audit teams.
• Develop practitioner-friendly tools – Revise and maintain audit templates, checklists and guidance. You ensure they remain compliant, user-friendly and efficient, striking the right balance between innovation, quality and practicality.
• Bridge innovation and compliance – Work closely with the Innovation Officer within Audit & Assurance to assess new audit tools and technologies. You provide compliance input, methodology requirements and risk assessments to ensure new solutions truly support the audit process.
• Contribute to audit technology initiatives – Collaborate with internal teams, international member firms and external partners (such as startups or solution providers) to explore new technologies that can strengthen the audit practice.
• Support pilots and implementations – Analyse the impact of new tools or methodology updates, help coordinate pilot projects and identify training or change management needs for our audit teams.
• Communicate changes clearly – Produce concise guidance, change logs and practitioner updates whenever templates, processes or standards evolve.
• Ensure consistency across technical initiatives – Work closely with other technical specialists to maintain alignment and quality across the different components of our audit methodology.
What do you bring to the table?
Your foundation:

• Minimum 5 years of experience in audit (Big Four, national firm or similar environment)
• Strong interest in audit standards, methodology and compliance
• Affinity with technology and experience with digital audit tools or data analytics
• Advanced Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, Power Query / Power Pivot; basic VBA is a plus)
• Experience with SharePoint or similar document management systems
• Experience developing templates, guidance documents or policy updates
• Professional qualification such as CPA, CA or CIA is a plus but not required
• Fluency in English; Dutch or French is an asset
 

Your personality:

• You enjoy translating complex technical requirements into clear, practical solutions
• You combine a strong compliance mindset with curiosity for new technologies
• You are structured and detail-oriented, with strong version control and documentation discipline
• You work independently and proactively, while collaborating smoothly with colleagues across teams
• You are comfortable managing multiple small projects simultaneously
• You’re motivated to collaborate internationally with other BDO member firms and contribute to shared initiatives

Responsibilities

• Serve as the technical lead for the product lifecycle, taking ownership of all technical aspects of both custom and off-the-shelf solutions.
• Translate complex business requirements into detailed functional and technical specifications while challenging existing workflows.
• Lead the implementation and configuration of geospatial products and integrated custom components.
• Oversee the build and deployment of solutions based on modern cloud and backend technologies.
• Coordinate with internal platforms and external suppliers to ensure adherence to security and technology standards.
• Perform technical evaluations and fit-gap analyses during software selection and procurement processes.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of experience in GIS solution design and operation within the Esri ArcGIS ecosystem, including Enterprise, Online, Pro, and APIs/SDKs.
• You bring 5+ years of experience in solution architecture, including functional design, data modelling, and fit-gap analysis.
• You possess extensive experience with geospatial data-integration tools such as Safe Software FME for spatial data transformation and automation.
• You have experience developing and integrating components using Microsoft technologies like .NET and SQL Server.
• You possess hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
• You bring a solid understanding of IT service management processes, security standards, and compliance requirements.
• You're a holder of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, or an equivalent field.
• You're proactive, autonomous, and comfortable managing multidisciplinary stakeholders.
• You are fluent in Dutch and/or French with a strong command of English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Vertigis Studio or Vertigis Integrator.
• Knowledge of the electricity or energy sector.

jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk. 

User support
  
• Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site 
• Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals 
• Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support 
• Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN) 
• Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)  
Access and security
  
• Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures 
• Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)  
Hardware and lifecycle
  
• Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals) 
• Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights) 
• Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals 
• Tickets, escalation and coordination 
• Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…) 
• Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs 
• Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers 
• Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions 
• Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)  
You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.
 
THE TEAM & THE MANAGER
 
Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential 
 
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT 
• At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support 
• Fluent French and English, both spoken and written 
• Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA 
• Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity  
Assets
  
• Knowledge of Arabic 
• Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer 
• Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment 
• IT certifications (CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)  
Soft skills
  
• Customer focus and service mindset 
• Autonomy and rigour in incident management 
• Clear communication with non-technical users 
• Hands-on, proactive attitude

Our client is a dynamic and growing company in the region of Oostende.

Jobomschrijving

Understanding exactly what a customer needs is essential. Do you believe listening is just as important as speaking? Then keep reading!

A selection of your responsibilities:

• You respond to customer enquiries by telephone and email, identify customers' needs and provide clear, helpful and professional support.
• You ensure a smooth and accurate order flow, from receiving orders to invoicing.
• You create, update and maintain customer accounts and ensure that customer information is complete and accurate.
• You support customers with webshop enquiries, online ordering, account access and other website-related issues.
• You assist with the day-to-day aministration of online webshops, including order follow-up, customer questions and issue resolution.
• You register and handle returns, claims and complaints in a timely manner and propose ways to prevent recurring issues.
• You maintain up-to-date knowledge of products, prices, promotions, procedures and online information to resolve customer questions effectively.
• You mainly support B2C customers, while also assisting professional customers such as retailers and wholesalers with orders, service requests and online tools.

We are looking for the following profile:

• You are a native English speaker with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
• You are customer-focused, empathetic, flexible and a strong communicator.
• You are confident handling a high volume of telephone calls and emails while maintaining accuracy and service quality.
• You are comfortable using webshops, online platforms, Microsoft Office and customer or order-management systems.
• You can set priorities, organize your work and follow customer requests through to completion.
• You are enthusiastic, eager to learn and enjoy working as part of a team.
• You are comfortable with routine administrative tastks and maintain a positive approach in every customer interaction.
• You have a commercial mindset and know how to combine customer focus with result-oriented working.
• You are available for a full-time position.

Zij zijn een innovatieve en groeiende speler in de verse voedingssector, waar kwaliteit, duurzaamheid en teamwork centraal staan. In een dynamische omgeving krijg je de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Samen bouwen ze elke dag aan sterke resultaten én een succesvolle toekomst.

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Shift Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily operations of a modern packaging and production department. You lead a team of approximately 150 employees across multiple packaging lines and ensure that production targets, quality standards and customer requirements are achieved efficiently and safely.

You are a visible leader on the shop floor, coaching and supporting your team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes, efficiency and performance.

What will you do?

• Lead and support a large operational team, including direct supervision of team leaders.
• Monitor production planning, quality, safety and productivity targets.
